panel: Same registered TRAIN-only component panel; adaptive diagnostic, no fresh confirmation
fit: Interior-only spread code map support3/confidence.95 and interior-to-interior movement map support3/confidence.80; no outside target fitting
event_origins: All outside-branch price-code event origins with current mapped spread; publication-row lengths used only as diagnostic weights
horizon: Next64 representation events, diagnostic future only
unknown_handling: Barrier can be graded only when all transitions before its first hit are known; no hit includes right truncation/unknown separately
barrier: Long loss if future bid-entry ask <=-(current spread+2); short loss if entry bid-future ask <=-(current spread+2)
prediction: Realized first-hit quote loss, including jump overshoot; compare actual losing offset k to first hit directional displacement
controls: Exact current spread+2 offset; first barrier displacement; future opposite-side quote displacement doubling control; common future bid/ask mark requires implied future spread=offset-winner>=1
falsifier: First-hit overshoot must materially beat constant2 on offset>2 episodes with adequate coverage; even-offset pattern itself does not establish stop execution
